ticket.subject: Card declined after security check
ticket.description: After the bank security check the page says the card was declined. I tried twice.

answer.summary: Card payment fails after the bank security check, booking not possible.
answer.customer_reply: We are sorry that your payment did not go through. Our team is looking into it. Please do not try again for now - we will update you as soon as we know more.

ticket.subject: Paid but booking still pending
ticket.description: The money is gone from my account, but the booking shows status pending.

answer.summary: Payment taken, booking stays pending without confirmation.
answer.customer_reply: We are sorry for the uncertainty. We are checking your payment and your booking and will get back to you with an update.

ticket.subject: Two payments for one ticket
ticket.description: I see two identical payments for the same ticket on my credit card statement.

answer.summary: Customer charged twice for one ticket.
answer.customer_reply: We are sorry for the double charge. We are checking the payments and will contact you about the correction.

ticket.subject: No night trains in search
ticket.description: The search does not show any night trains to Vienna, although they run every day.

answer.summary: Search shows no night trains to Vienna.
answer.customer_reply: Thank you for telling us. We are looking into the search results for night trains.

ticket.subject: Add a bike
ticket.description: Can I add a bike reservation to my existing booking?

answer.summary: Request to add a bike reservation to an existing booking.
answer.customer_reply: Thank you for your request. Our service team will check the options for your booking and get back to you.

ticket.subject: Receipt missing
ticket.description: Where can I find the receipt for my last trip?

answer.summary: Customer asks for the receipt of the last trip.
answer.customer_reply: Thank you for your message. Our service team will send you the receipt.
